item.title: Kyiv's new reality: Russian drones by night — and now by day
item.description: More than a week of strikes by jet-powered Russian drones has disrupted schools, work and transport … and left Ukraine, which lacks air defense supplies, feeling vulnerable.

item.title: Trump asks SCOTUS to OK changes to mail-in ballots. And, diesel prices hit record high
item.description: Trump has asked the Supreme Court to lift the block on his plan for the USPS to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterm elections. And, diesel prices have reached a record high.

item.title: Germany's far-right AfD party is poised for power in a state election

item.title: Rescuers pull 2 trapped workers from a hydropower tunnel 9 days after Nepal floods
item.description: Officials say rescuers in Nepal have pulled two workers alive from a tunnel Friday during an ongoing operation. The rescues come nine days after the Aug. 26 floods.

item.title: As El Niño intensifies, Rio turns to science — and a spiritual adviser
item.description: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.
item.content:encoded: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.

item.title: Nepali community in Texas grieves and prays for healing after flash floods
item.description: Nepalese groups in North Texas, which has one of the largest communities of people from Nepal in the U.S., continue to grieve the loss of hundreds of people after the devastating floods in August.
